body:
Have two prescriptions for ambien. Tonight I took 10mg. In the beginning I didn't receive any kind of drowsiness.
T+.05 - smoked a cigarette
T+.40 - smoked a cigarette
T+ 1.00 - took another 10mg
T+ 1.30 - smoked a cigarette
T+ 2.00 - took another 10mg
Right now I have 30 mg in my system and I still feel normal. Did I do something wrong? I didn't even have to fight off sleep, that feeling never came. I know I have a high tolerance but this is ridiculous.
